name: wenflow
description: 问流 / WenFlow - 从真实问题出发的 AI 学习路径原型（先澄清目标，再生成路径）

scripts.security:scan: npm run security:scan:current && npm run security:scan:history
scripts.database:backup:create: npm run build:backend && npm --prefix backend run database:backup:create --
scripts.database:backup:verify: npm run build:backend && npm --prefix backend run database:backup:verify --
scripts.database:vacuum:status: npm run build:backend && npm --prefix backend run database:vacuum:status
scripts.database:vacuum: npm run build:backend && npm --prefix backend run database:vacuum --
scripts.check:quality: npm run security:scan:current && npm run prisma:validate && npm run prisma:migrate:verify-clean && npm run typecheck:backend && npm run check:frontend-types && npm run llm:calls:check && npm --prefix backend run constants:check && npm --prefix backend run prisma:migrate:deploy:all && npm --prefix backend run prompts:seed-routings && npm run prompts:check && npm run prompts:core:check && npm run prompts:runtime-contract:check && npm run design:check && npm --prefix backend run boundaries:check && npm run lint
scripts.check:test: npm --prefix backend run test:coverage && npm --prefix frontend run test:coverage
scripts.check:build: npm run build:backend && npm run build:frontend
scripts.check: npm run check:quality && npm run check:test && npm run check:build
scripts.lint: npm --prefix backend run lint && npm --prefix frontend run lint
